audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[0..2] reads Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank and the full phases repeat it, but the packet chart is Sylas/Sylas/Skill and the prose agrees with the packet: whys[0] says 'my lone early keg is on too long a cooldown to punish him', whys[1] says 'He E-dashes onto me, stuns, and drains with Q/W', and whys[2] says only that 'It's close'. The early section states outright that 'Sylas owns the first three levels'.
audit.why: Chain Lash shoves at 775 range and Kingslayer heals the trade back before Gangplank has a second keg charge; the lane only levels out once extra E points shorten the keg cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 set to Sylas/Sylas/Skill in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Sylas's level 1-3 shove-and-bully, Gangplank's level 4-5 keg cooldown reduction, the Sheen window, and Hijack stealing Cannon Barrage. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carries no cooldowns and never names Chain Lash, Kingslayer, Petricite Burst or Hijack. Most importantly it never prices the interaction that governs every teamfight: Hijack is 80/55/30 while Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120, so at rank 3 he copies your ultimate on a quarter of your cooldown.
audit.why: Riot text and kit data: Chain Lash (Q) 10/9/8/7/6 at 775 range; Kingslayer (W) 12/10.5/9/7.5/6 at 400 range, 'dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions'; Abscond/Abduct (E) 13/12/11/10/9, 400-range dash with a recast that pulls him to an enemy hit; Hijack (R) 80/55/30 at 950 range, 'steals the enemy's ultimate ability'.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and the Hijack-versus-Cannon-Barrage ratio written into the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer despite four sequencing cues in the packet.
audit.why: Abscond at 13s rank 1 and Kingslayer at 12s falling to 6s are the two windows that decide whether a step-up is punishable.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says 'anti-heal stays core' without naming the ability responsible.
audit.why: Kingslayer (W) heals Sylas against enemy champions on a cooldown that falls to 6 seconds, which is what turns his short trades into net-positive ones.
